Indian High Courts Address Various Legal and Social Issues

Several Indian High Courts have been active in recent legal proceedings. The Karnataka High Court is examining claims against a doctor regarding viral content about Nandini milk and has allowed a probe into the doctor. Separately, the Kerala High Court has admitted an appeal in a high-profile actor assault case and upheld a Drugs Controller's power to regulate misleading medical discount boards. Other High Courts have issued strong statements on police conduct and court efficiency.
